items.title: Joey Morant interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 2, 2013
items.q: Because I’ve heard that before from Billy Eckstine’s son, Ed Eckstine, who is still alive and well in a rep company.

ctx.x: Thank you, sir. It’s an honor to hear that. Because I’ve heard that before from Billy Eckstine’s son, Ed Eckstine, who is still alive and well in a rep company. Roy Eldridge. I knew his daughter very well too, Carol, before she died.
Well what is it — can you tell me what you think about when you play a solo?
